page.overview:
Who is Peddy Tuxpin?

was a panda bear played by Sam Riegel in and .

Peddy grew up in the Shattered Teeth, far south of the continent of Wildemount. When he was just a child, his family was hunted by poachers with guns. His father told him to run and Peddy never saw his family ever again.

Peddy's name is a satrical pun off of the famous toy line Teddy Ruxpin
